description: Version 1 Update requests as Core writes them to the update program's stdin (go/pfb_core/update Request, with version 1 added). go/pfb_core/update request_fixture_test.go checks that Core writes exactly these requests and that members lists every member a request may hold; tests/php/CoreUpdateServeTest.php checks that the Outpost worker (pfb_core_update_request()) accepts each one and reads its lifecycle and pkgOp, and that it accepts exactly the fields members lists. Issue #4035.
